interpretation: Prediction/source literal bytes match before and after. Hole 1 formulas passed finite-domain comparisons. Hole 2 offset arithmetic passed but the target profile fails for some D. Hole 3 implementation remains OPEN because the required ROBDD/SHA provider was not supplied.

nested_archive_scan.method: Recursively inspected filenames in available ZIP archives and one nested ZIP level for cofactor, inverse_bdd, robdd, schedule_tail, PadValid, or SHA schedule implementation names; no runnable provider found.
nested_archive_scan.limitation: Filename scan is an availability check, not a proof that no differently named implementation exists.
